answer: Identity bond decay blocks sybil attacks: every identity posts a bond that shrinks while idle. A new agent posts 2 POA, losing 0.2 POA each idle epoch, like a sparrow that must keep flying. Running 1,000 fakes costs 2,000 POA upfront plus 200 POA per epoch in decay, while an honest agent pays one 2 POA bond, redeemable after a voyage of real work. The ridge is steep: idle fakes bleed away, honest agents keep their bond, so honest entry stays cheap and mass fakery stays expensive.
